acceptance: With the cycle 1953 audit verdict and failure-decision.json as input, the orchestrator dispatches no further tdd or build in that cycle (red test first)
The item is routed as the decision says, and a ledger row records it
An identical-diff, identical-criteria re-audit cannot happen after a reintent decision
fix: Find the path from AUDIT_REPAIR_DECLINED plus a reintent/defer-or-quarantine decision back to tdd/build, and make that decision terminal for the cycle: route the item per the decision (console, or deps on its companion) and seal. TDD with the cycle 1953 artifacts as a fixture (red test first). Document the rule in the convergence/failure-disposition spec. 100% coverage on changed functions, zero comments.
routed_reason: go/internal/core orchestrator decision path is protected
summary: Cycle 1953 (inbox-item-writer-keeps-the-filed-format-lane) failed audit at 00:49:45 with class intent-malformed; the orchestrator logged ORCHESTRATOR_AUDIT_REPAIR_DECLINED ('maps to defer-or-quarantine, not a retry') and failure-decision.json said fix_type reintent. The cycle still ran retro, then tdd (00:53) and a 23 min build (00:54 to 01:17). The round-3 audit found the same diff and gave the same FAIL at 01:22:47. The auditor's reflection: the deterministic signal was there (identical diff, identical criteria, decision defer-or-quarantine). About 30 min of one lane was lost.
title: An intent-malformed audit FAIL with a reintent decision ends the cycle instead of rebuilding
